Equation Editor — Write & Edit LaTeX in the Browser

Write LaTeX equations with a live KaTeX preview, fix the maths a PDF extraction got wrong, and drop formulas straight into table cells. Runs entirely in your browser — nothing is uploaded and the renderer is bundled, so it works offline.

What you can do

  • Live KaTeX preview as you type, with the actual parse error when the TeX will not compile
  • Symbol palette for fractions, roots, sums, integrals, matrices, cases and Greek letters
  • Inline cell maths — a table cell written as $…$ renders as a typeset formula
  • Edit equations extracted from a PDF and push the corrected LaTeX back to the source region
  • KaTeX is bundled, not loaded from a CDN — equations render offline
